Name: RitzyGen's Furniture Collection
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
Hello Everybody, I recently decided to make a furniture mod, Despite my horrible pixel art skills.
Surprisingly, so far it has turned out somewhat okay, or at least better than I thought it would be (lol)

[size=4]The Furniture set(s) currently contain:[/size]
Froggy set: Double Bed, Child's Bed, Armchair, End Table, Dining chair, 2 Large Plushies, 2 Small Plushies, a Mirror(4x4 painting, non-reflective), Lamp, Rug, Succulent, NightLight, Decorative Crib, Single Book, Book Stack, and a Small Painting.

I pinky promise I will add more furniture later.
[size=4]
REQUIREMENTS:
[/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifier[/url][/size][size=4],﻿ [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher,[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]

[size=3]
[size=4]Install Instructions:[/size][/size][size=4]
Move the .zip file into your Stardew Valley/Mods Folder.[/size]

I also will take requests/suggestions, If anyone has them. Users will be credited for the idea.
Please note that my skills are not perfect, And if my ability is not up to the task, I will likely not be able to do it, at least not to the quality you are hoping.

Recolors are allowed, If you want to make one.


Notes: I use a ReShade preset that changes the game's screen color slightly, so the furniture's color may look a little different on your screen.
